name: Tommy Bahama Miramonte Resort & Spa
insider_take: This desert oasis perfectly captures the laid-back luxury of Tommy Bahama's island lifestyle, set against the dramatic backdrop of the Santa Rosa Mountains in California's premier golf destination.
whats_special: Tommy Bahama Miramonte is the brand's first and only resort property, featuring their signature island-inspired design with desert sophistication. The resort sits on 11 acres of manicured gardens with stunning mountain views, and guests enjoy exclusive access to the on-site Tommy Bahama restaurant and retail store - the only location where you can shop, dine, and sleep all in one place.
pro_tip: Book a treatment at the Well Spa during sunset hours - the floor-to-ceiling windows offer breathtaking views of the mountains as they turn golden, creating an unforgettable spa experience.
dont_miss: Indian Wells is home to the BNP Paribas Open tennis tournament (often called the "5th Grand Slam"), and you're just minutes from world-class golf courses including the Stadium Course at PGA West. The nearby Living Desert Zoo showcases native desert wildlife and botanical gardens spanning 1,800 acres.
pros: Distinctive Tommy Bahama brand experience with island-inspired luxury design
Full-service spa offering rejuvenating treatments in desert oasis setting
Prime Indian Wells location with easy access to golf courses and shopping
Multiple dining venues featuring tropical-inspired cuisine and craft cocktails
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and brand exclusivity
Specific brand aesthetic may not appeal to all travelers
